issues.issue: [fixed: category utilities (function line)] The expense statement lists spending by utility function (Production and procurement, Distribution, Customer accounting and collecting, Administrative and general), not by cost type. Customer accounting and collecting is a function line like Distribution, so under the utility cost-type rule it stays category utilities. It is not a contract-services object.
Utility late-payment penalties put in charges for services. This is defensible, but it could also be treated as fines/penalties.

issues.on_page: Payments to the city and villages 183,275
issues.issue: Likely in-lieu-of-tax or franchise payments to the city and villages, so Other Taxes Paid or a payments-to-other-entities category may fit better than the utilities function. The page does not say.
Amortization of bond issue cost is in other. Depreciation/amortization, or debt service fees, would be more specific than other.
